A. Youngest job first
B. Least frequently used
C. Round-robin
D. Most recently used
E. Longest job first
F. Random job selection
G. Priority queuing
H. Shortest job first

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
